description: Scan company career pages to detect GTM hiring activity: open sales, marketing, and revenue operations roles, a role count, and a high, medium, or low signal strength. Reads the Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters and Personio job boards; a company on any other board returns a null ats_platform and a zero count, not an error. Use it to qualify an account before outreach, or on a schedule in velocity mode to see whether a company is ramping its GTM team. Use mode batch with domains for a list in one call. Output is Clay-ready flat JSON, one row per company. Requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per call.

ats_slug.description: Optional ATS board slug override for when it differs from the domain. Example: clay.com uses claylabs on Ashby. If omitted, the scraper auto-probes common slug variants.

domain.description: Bare company domain without https:// and without a trailing slash. Example: stripe.com

domains.description: List of bare domains to scan in one run when mode is "batch", for example ["stripe.com", "figma.com"]. One row per company. The run timeout is 1,800 seconds; a very large batch can still reach it.

include_role_details.description: When true, include the full per-role detail array (title, department, location, url) in the output. Default: false.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before the next result that would take this run's charges over this amount, and keeps every result already charged. Leave empty to rely only on the maximum cost per run you set in Apify.

mode.description: Processing mode. "single" scores the domain. "batch" scores every entry in domains in one run, one row per company. "velocity" compares this run against previous_gtm_role_count and previous_run_date to report role changes since last time. Default: "single".

previous_gtm_role_count.description: GTM role count from the previous run for this domain. Used in velocity mode to compute the delta, which is what makes a scheduled run cheap.

previous_run_date.description: ISO date of the previous run for this domain, e.g. 2026-07-15. Used in velocity mode to report days between runs.

role_filter.description: Optional list of GTM role keywords to filter on. Defaults to the built-in GTM keyword list if omitted.

name: scan_gtm_hiring_signals
title: Scan GTM Hiring Signals
